_about: Demo scene for the IWRL6432BOOST radar (site/boardviz/scene.js). Steps are the board's flash-mode steps and the room test; the field of view and the person are drawn smaller than the board, one floor tick per metre. New actions: dip (move one slider of a DIP switch: pos from the bottom, state on or off), move (slide a thing or part: to or by), stand (stand the board on its bottom edge, antenna toward -x; height is the board center in mm above the floor).
title: Radar presence on the IWRL6432BOOST

things.label: USB cable
things.title: Micro-USB cable
things.text: A micro-USB B cable from your computer. It carries power and both serial ports.

things.label: Field of view
things.title: Where the radar looks
things.text: TI quotes 120 degrees across and 80 degrees up and down for the full antenna set. Rings mark 2 m, 4 m and 6.5 m, where a walk-in was first flagged. Drawn smaller than the board.

things.label: Person
things.title: A person walking in
things.text: In the timed test a person starts 8 m out and walks toward the board, then sits still at 2 m and 4 m. Drawn smaller than the board.

things.label: Stand
things.title: Stand
things.text: A stand that holds the board upright. Any stand or tripod works.

things.label: Stand
things.title: Stand
things.text: A stand that holds the board upright. Any stand or tripod works.

steps.title: Plug in the micro-USB cable
steps.text: Leave the switches as shipped. Push the cable into J5, the micro-USB port on the top edge. The green 5 V light D6 and the amber power-good light D3 come on, and the demo already in flash starts streaming four frames a second.

steps.title: Stand it up, antenna toward the room
steps.text: Put the board on a stand about 1.5 m up, antenna side toward the room, and keep 20 cm between you and the board. The teal wedge is where it looks, out to 6.5 m. The floor ticks are one metre apart. The room is drawn smaller than the board.

steps.title: A person walks in
steps.text: In the timed test a person starts 8 m out and walks in. With the 2 by 3 antenna setting the board first flagged the walker at about 6.5 m. Each frame, about four a second, says which of four floor zones has someone in it. It arrives as text on your computer.
